summary: Baseline release of Lead Opportunity Dashboard
features: Executive Summary cards displaying lead overview, priority stars, GBP status, and organic rank.
Deterministic Opportunity Score (0-100) and weighted rating algorithms.
Google Business Profile matching engine with domain matching and city proximity filtering.
Technical Analysis consolidation of HTTPS, response status, canonical tags, and title/description metadata.
Outreach Strategy angles, Suggested First Email draft copy, and persistent manual annotations.
bugfixes: Added Cloudflare challenge interstitial title detection and Puppeteer browser fallback parser.
notes: Version 1.0 serves as the baseline dashboard release separating technical insights from business opportunities.

summary: Bulk analysis workflow and search results layout refinements
features: Added Analyse All Results bulk sequence execution engine.
Sequential analysis queue with live progressive progress indicators (e.g. Analysing 4 of 25...).
Smart caching and auto-restoration of Opportunity Score and View Analysis states on search refreshes.
Reordered Search Results table placing numeric Score column immediately after Position/Rating.
Subtle colored status indicators (Red/Orange/Green) for commercial opportunity levels.
Enabled client-side interactive sorting for Position/Rating, Score, and Domain/URL columns.
bugfixes: Fixed ReferenceError for fallbackOpportunity inside catch block when scraping fails.

summary: Outreach Packs lifecycle, automated contact email discovery with SPA/domain stem handling, manual email editing fallback, and email preview workflow
features: Server-backed independent Outreach Packs with fixed membership and sequential numbering (OP0001, OP0002...).
Automated contact email discovery scanning homepage, footers, and contact sub-pages with Puppeteer SPA fallback.
Support for legitimate brand stem domain email variations while filtering out third-party/agency addresses.
Inline manual email edit control (pencil icon) in pack detail with immediate SQLite persistence and re-crawl protection.
Separated personalised greeting derivation (e.g. Hi Mark / Hi there) from shared editable pack email template.
Exact-match email preview modal stepping through all selected recipients prior to sending.
Outreach Shortlist UI cleanup with Domain column simplification and pack assignment status badges (In OP0001 / Ready for Pack).
bugfixes: Fixed SPA client-rendered sites (e.g. React root shells) missing footer contact details by triggering Puppeteer rendering.
Fixed domain variation matching for companies whose email domain differs from their website stem (e.g. astonlilyshutters vs astonlily).
Fixed template editor opening with blank fields by synchronizing subject and body from server-backed pack template.
Prevented manual greetings entered in the template editor from polluting all recipient greetings.
notes: Version 1.3 stabilizes the complete Outreach Pack preparation workflow, email crawler, manual editing fallback, and preview system.
